name: 20% HELP debt reduction
summary: Student loan debts that existed on 1 June 2025 were cut by 20%, and repayments now come only from income above the threshold.
key: Automatic. Every study and training loan debt that existed on 1 June 2025 was reduced by 20%.
numbers: All study and training support debts that existed on 1 June 2025
Worked out only on income above the minimum threshold, not on your whole income
how: You don't need to apply. Check the change in your loan account through the ATO app or ATO online services in myGov.
catches: If the cut left your loan in credit, the ATO generally refunded it to your nominated bank account, as long as you had no other tax or Commonwealth debts.
If you paid your loan by card, you may need to contact the ATO for a manual refund.
If you earn $179,286 or more, your repayments don't change.

source.label: ATO: study and training loans, what's new
